notes: Expands the AO3 Required-Tag Grid editor to cover every state supplied by the AO3 key: all five ratings plus Second Square; F/F, F/M, Gen, M/M, Multi, Other, No Category plus Third Square; Chose Not To Warn, Warnings Apply, No Warnings, External Work globe plus Fourth Square; Complete, WIP, and blank completion. Every state now has its own box color, icon/font color, icon size, border color, and border width. F/M gets separately editable female/male halves and Multi gets four independently editable quadrants. Adds a live All AO3 Grid States reference board and exports the customizations to AO3 CSS. Keeps Color Studio, Gradient Studio, GIF support, Split Screen, and all prior tools.
